notes.title: Zold:out Early Access version with Chinese Server
notes.notes:
Semi-turn-based Tactical RPG, Zold:out is released on Steam with Early Access.

Early Access version is the same server with the current mobile version. Current mobile user can login the same account to get your game data.

Full version on Steam will be released with Global server, which main language will be English, with other language support like Japanese. Global version on mobile and Steam will be released at the same time. Global server will be a new start for all users. 

We are finalizing the translation. The Full version should be came out in Early 2023.

Thank you for your support on our development. Our dev team is trying our best to develop more and more content and game system.

Global Pre-Registration on Mobile
Pre-Registration of the mobile version is started. Global Server on Steam will be released with mobile simultaneously. 
App Store
Google Play
For Steam, you can simply add Zold:out into wishlist. You will be notified when Global Server released.
